payload.name: Extract nickname relationships from address terms
payload.description: When a dialogue message contains a speaker addressing another person by a name that differs from the addressee's full name, extract a nickname relationship even if the message's main topic is an event.
content: During extraction, scan direct-address terms (greetings, vocatives) in each message and compare them against the full names of the conversation participants.
When a direct-address term is a shortened or alternative form of a participant's full name, create a relationship memory recording that the speaker uses that term as a nickname for that participant.
Add this nickname relationship independently of any event/state memory extracted from the same message; do not drop address terms because another fact seems more salient.

solves: The construction extraction step can over-focus on a message's main event and discard direct-address nicknames as incidental, leaving later nickname queries unanswerable. The reusable fix is to treat any non-full-name address term as an independent relationship fact during extraction. This applies to future dialogue where a nickname appears in a greeting or vocative; it does not apply to generic pronouns, formal titles, or address terms matching the full name.
